parameters.query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE voice_jobs SET status = 'completed', provider = 'vast-fish-adapter', model = 'fish-s2-pro', voice_id = 'honi', audio_uri = '{{ $('Validar y compilar Fish').item.json.audio_uri }}', completed_at_utc = now(), updated_at_utc = now() WHERE id = {{ $('Validar y compilar Fish').item.json.voice_job_id }} AND status = 'processing' RETURNING script_type, script_id, individual_script_id) UPDATE daily_news_scripts script SET status = 'voiced', updated_at_utc = now() FROM updated WHERE updated.script_type = 'daily_news' AND script.id = updated.script_id; UPDATE individual_scripts script SET status = 'voiced', updated_at_utc = now() FROM voice_jobs job WHERE job.id = {{ $('Validar y compilar Fish').item.json.voice_job_id }} AND job.script_type = 'individual' AND script.id = job.individual_script_id;

parameters.content:
## Contrato seguro de audio

- Sólo reclama narración Creative aprobada con Production Plan `ready`.
- El compilador rechaza cualquier beat que no reconstruya la narración exacta, anchors ausentes o tags Fish no permitidos.
- Configure `VAST_FISH_ADAPTER` como URL base y la credencial Header Auth sin exportar secretos.
- Mantenga el workflow inactivo hasta una prueba manual autorizada.
